name: Bethany Volunteer Fire Department
_urlNote: Canonical domain is undecided (bethanyfirect.org or bethanyctfire.org). Override at build time with SITE_URL; the GitHub Pages workflow sets it automatically. See docs/LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md.

donate._note: Paste the hosted_button_id from the existing PayPal Donate button here. Until then the page shows a mail-in fallback.

legal._note: EIN is NOT shown on the site until einVerified is true. Treasurer to confirm the exact legal name and EIN.
legal.name: Bethany Volunteer Fireman's Association

analytics._note: Optional privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible). Set a domain to enable; the Content-Security-Policy allows plausible.io automatically.

flags._note: Launch gates. Each is false until the named person has signed off. scripts/check.mjs lists any that are still false.
